traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS are implemented and verified. The valid-annotation-format rule now accepts configurable regex patterns and examples for story paths and requirement IDs via both nested (story/req) and flat (storyPathPattern/storyPathExample/requirementIdPattern/requirementIdExample) options. Invalid regex sources are detected, reported via an invalidRuleConfiguration diagnostic, and safely reverted to default patterns, ensuring backward compatibility. Error messages use the configured example strings when provided, and nested configuration correctly overrides flat shorthand, as enforced by dedicated tests. JSON Schema in getRuleSchema validates configuration shape according to ESLint best practices. Integration with valid-story-reference remains consistent: defaults align with docs/stories-based paths and storyDirectories behavior is unchanged and tested. The rule’s documentation clearly explains configurable patterns, shorthand mapping, defaults, and example configurations. Jest tests for this rule and for valid-story-reference all pass, providing strong evidence that the story’s requirements and acceptance criteria are fully met.
